purpose: Machine-readable authority boundary for 420 Governance integration with shared Genesis protocols and derived consumers.

canonicalAuthority.compatibilityRole: bootstrap/compatibility only; never proposal, vote, outcome, or normal execution authority

integrations.name: 420Registry
integrations.authority: ProtocolRegistry may publish/resolve Civic modules and service metadata; Registry data never determines proposal validity, voting weight, tally, finalization, or execution authority.
requiredEvidence: Civic core has no ProtocolRegistry runtime dependency

integrations.name: 420Stake
integrations.authority: Validator stake/bond/delegation amounts do not create Civic voting weight. Canonical validator electorate is one eligible active-validator owner = one vote via CivicMerkleElectorateSource420.
requiredEvidence: no Stake420/ValidatorRegistry runtime import in Civic core
validator electorate weight returns exactly 1 for a valid member
validator source type is frozen equal-weight Merkle v1

integrations.name: 420Treasury
integrations.authority: GovernanceTimelock may create budgets/schedule/cancel disbursements. Budget and disbursement records bind a nonzero civicActionHash; Treasury execution remains capability-scoped and cannot vote or execute Civic proposals.

integrations.name: 420Vault
integrations.authority: GovernanceTimelock may mutate Vault policy where contracts expose onlyGovernance, but asset release/custody remains Vault capability/route/beneficiary controlled. Civic never directly owns Vault assets.
requiredEvidence: Vault authorization independent of Civic voting
Governance core has no custody path

integrations.name: 420Wallet
integrations.authority: Wallet verifies chain, Registry component resolution, code identity/version and module graph before presenting or submitting votes. Wallet may not manufacture governance authority.

integrations.name: 420Indexer
integrations.authority: Indexer reconstructs Civic events from qualified artifacts and chain history. Projection state cannot vote, finalize, queue, execute or overwrite canonical Civic state.

integrations.name: 420Search
integrations.authority: Search indexes public protocol objects as non-canonical results with source provenance; rankings/results cannot alter Governance.

integrations.name: 420Explorer
integrations.authority: Explorer observes 420Indexer/chain state only and has no governance authority.

integrations.name: 420Notifications
integrations.authority: Notifications may surface Governance proposals/deadlines but cannot create canonical events, mutate protocol state, sign transactions, or bypass Wallet authorization.

integrations.name: other_genesis_systemaccess_consumers
integrations.authority: Contracts outside the Civic implementation may accept GovernanceTimelock as a caller through SystemAccess/onlyGovernance, but must not import Civic proposal/voting modules or become a reciprocal Governance dependency.

invariants: GOV7-INV-001: GovernanceTimelock is the only external mutation identity exposed by canonical Civic execution.
GOV7-INV-002: ProtocolRegistry is discovery/publication authority only and never Civic voting/outcome/execution authority.
GOV7-INV-003: Validator stake, bond size, reward, delegation, or protocol credit never scales Civic validator voting weight.
GOV7-INV-004: Treasury governed records bind Civic action commitments while Treasury execution/custody remains bounded by Treasury/Vault authorization.
GOV7-INV-005: Governance does not gain direct custody by targeting Vault/Treasury contracts.
GOV7-INV-006: Wallet, Indexer, Search, Explorer, and Notifications are replaceable consumers and cannot alter canonical Governance outcomes.
GOV7-INV-007: No Genesis resident forms a circular authority dependency back into Civic proposal, vote, finalization, or execution.
GOV7-INV-008: Deprecated Governance420 proposal/vote/result paths remain retired and are never used as canonical Civic state.
